segments.name: oil and natural gas
segments.description: Independent oil and natural gas company that acquires, develops, exploits and produces oil and natural gas properties at Bairoil and Beta for customers.
segments.evidence: Our management evaluates performance based on one reportable business segment, as the economic environments are not different within the operation of our oil and natural gas properties.

revenueModel.text: The company sells oil, natural gas and NGLs from its properties to a small number of significant customers who pay for production sales.
revenueModel.evidence: We are dependent upon a small number of significant customers for the majority of our production sales.

changes.text: Sold its non-operated Eagle Ford assets in 2025.
changes.evidence: In July 2025, we closed a transaction to divest our non-operated Eagle Ford assets for a total purchase price of $23.0 million, excluding $1.9 million of final post-closing adjustments, resulting in a final adjusted purchase price of $21.1 million.

changes.text: Sold its East Texas and Louisiana oil and gas properties to EQV Alpha LLC in 2025.

changes.text: Sold its Oklahoma oil and gas properties to Revolution Resources III, LLC in 2025.
changes.evidence: During 2025, as discussed below, we completed several divestiture transactions, including the sale of our non-operated Eagle Ford assets in July 2025, our East Texas/North Louisiana assets in December 2025, and our Oklahoma assets in December 2025.
